sections.label: SMU survey on cleanliness satisfaction
sections.summary: An SMU survey found nine in 10 Singaporeans satisfied with public space cleanliness and proud of keeping Singapore clean.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Nine in 10 Singaporeans expressed satisfaction with the cleanliness of our public spaces and take pride in keeping Singapore clean, according to a survey by the Singapore Management University or SMU.

sections.label: SMU survey littering and tray views
sections.summary: One in five respondents found leaving rubbish acceptable if litter was present, and one in three said cleaners should return trays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: One in five respondents to the SMU survey thought it acceptable to leave rubbish around if there was already litter in the area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: One in three respondents believed that it is the cleaners' responsibility to return trays.

sections.label: Outbreaks linked to contaminated environments
sections.summary: These outbreaks, linked to contaminated environments, affected more than 1,200 people.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Linked to contaminated environments, these outbreaks affected more than 1,200 people.

sections.label: Toilet Improvement Programme and cleaning steps
sections.summary: NEA announced the Toilet Improvement Programme for hawker centres and coffee shops, with Clean Right and Audit the Results as steps for premises owners.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To support premises owners in rejuvenating infrastructure, the National Environment Agency or NEA recently announced the Toilet Improvement Programme for hawker centres and coffee shops, to incentivise premises to renovate ageing toilet infrastructure.  "Clean Right" and "Audit the Results" are important steps where premises owners adopt proper cleaning regime as guided by NEA's advisories on cleaning and disinfection.

sections.label: Co-developing environmental sanitation standards
sections.summary: Environmental sanitation standards will be co-developed with industry partners and progressively implemented from mid-2021, starting with higher risk premises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Second, we will work with industry partners to co-develop environmental sanitation standards applicable to their respective sectors and tailored to their needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will progressively implement these from mid-2021, starting with higher risk premises with immuno-vulnerable occupants, high footfall or a history of outbreaks, such as our pre-schools, schools, youth and eldercare facilities, hawker centres and coffee shops.

sections.label: ECCs to ECOs career pathway
sections.summary: The Bill provides a career progression pathway for ECCs to become ECOs, with 3,800 ECCs to be trained from the first quarter of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This will provide a career progression pathway for ECCs to become ECOs, as they gain experience and upgrade their skills to take on more responsibilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We expect to train 3,800 ECCs from the first quarter of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Environmental Public Health (Amendment) Bill establishes an environmental sanitation regime for specified premises, and regulatory regimes for aquatic facilities and aerosol-generating systems.

sections.label: Duties of ECC or ECO
sections.summary: New section 62B sets out duties of the ECC or ECO, including developing an environmental sanitation programme, monitoring implementation and recommending remedial measures for defaults.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The new section 62B prescribes the duties of the ECC or ECO, which include developing an environmental sanitation programme for the specified premises, monitoring its implementation and recommending remedial measures to address any default in implementation.

sections.label: Director-General closure and aquatic licensing
sections.summary: New section 62C empowers the Director-General to issue directives to close, clean or disinfect premises or public service vehicles, and licensing is extended to more aquatic facilities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The new section 62C empowers the Director-General to issue directives to close any premises, clean or disinfect the premises or any public service vehicle, or take other necessary measures in respect of the premises or public service vehicle, to prevent or manage health risks or disease outbreaks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Presently, swimming pools are the only type of aquatic facilities licensable under the EPHA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will extend our licensing regime to more categories of aquatic facilities, such as multi-use spa pools and water playgrounds, which have become commonplace in Singapore.

sections.label: Registration of aerosol-generating systems
sections.summary: New section 66A requires owners or occupiers of premises with a registrable aerosol-generating system to register it with the Director-General before use or operation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To strengthen our ability to respond to potential health risks, such as in the event of an outbreak, the new section 66A requires the owner or occupier of any premises with a registrable aerosol-generating system to register it with the Director-General prior to its use or operation.

sections.label: GPC proposals on toilets and cleaners
sections.summary: The GPC proposes a public toilet cleanliness grading system linked to licence renewal or tax rebates, expanded premises scope, cleaner training and fair labour practices, and no cost-of-living increase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: First, the GPC proposes that we implement a grading system to measure the cleanliness of public toilets and incentivise operators by linking these grades to licence renewal or tax rebates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Second, the GPC proposes that the Ministry reviews and considers expanding the scope of premises covered by the Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Third, the GPC proposes that cleaners be trained in suitable languages and formats, and be treated with fair labour practices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Fourth, The GPC hopes that the proposed amendments will not result in an increase in the cost of living.

sections.label: Fair labour practices for cleaners
sections.summary: The speaker proposes raising employment standards under the Enhanced Clean Mark Accreditation scheme, requiring sufficient breaks and rest days without reducing cleaners' take-home salary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: How is the Government going to ensure safe and sustainable labour standards with added labour?" Can Minister share how we intend to ensure that cleaners are treated with fair labour practices?

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I propose we start by raising the employment standards required of cleaning companies under the Enhanced Clean Mark Accreditation scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Specifically, let us require that companies provide cleaners, whether foreign or local, with sufficient breaks and rest days without reducing their take-home salary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Our increased hygiene standards can only be sustainable if cleaners are well rested and adequately paid.

sections.label: GPC support for the Bill
sections.summary: The GPC for Sustainability and the Environment stands in strong support of the Bill notwithstanding the clarifications.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding our clarifications, the GPC for Sustainability and the Environment stands in strong support of the Bill.

sections.label: Environmental sanitation Act amendment
sections.summary: The amendment introduces environmental sanitation programmes for NEA-designated premises, regulates aquatic facilities and aerosol-generating systems, and requires registered ECCs and ECOs for oversight.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: Amendment to this Act is timely as it introduces the environmental sanitation programmes for premises designated by NEA, regulate aquatic facilities and aerosol-generating systems and mandates the need for registered Environmental Control Coordinators or ECCs and Environmental Control Officers or ECOs to have better oversight at the specified premises.

sections.label: SMU study on toilet hygiene
sections.summary: An SMU study revealed a dip in public hygiene standards in coffee shop and hawker centre toilets since 2016.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: As my colleague, Mr Louis Ng has just pointed out, from the recent study by SMU, it has revealed that there has been a dip in public hygiene standards in toilets at coffee shops and hawker centres since 2016.

sections.label: Improving public toilet conditions
sections.summary: There is a pressing need to markedly improve public toilet conditions across Singapore to reduce viral gastroenteritis diseases and related transmission in public spaces.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: To reduce the viral gastroenteritis diseases and the related transmission in public spaces, there is a pressing need to markedly improve the conditions of public toilets across Singapore, whether it is from the coffee shops to those in the MRTs, schools, childcare and the eldercare facilities.

sections.label: Grading tied to Premise Manager
sections.summary: Pegging public toilet grading to the Premise Manager's ability to run the entire premise would place some responsibility on operators to upkeep high sanitation standards.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: By pegging the grading of public toilets to the Premise Manager's ability in running the entire premise would put some responsibility on these operators in upkeeping the high standards of sanitation in public toilets.

sections.label: UK Behavioural Insights Team nudge
sections.summary: The UK's Behavioural Insights Team, or Nudge Unit, started in 2010 to apply behavioural science to public policy, using nudges to do more with less.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: UK's Behavioural Insights Team, also known as the Nudge Unit started in 2010 to apply behavioural science to public policy of which one approach would be the nudge which aims to "do more with less", making simple and small changes in the design of the environment to bring about greater change in societal behaviours.

sections.label: HPB National Steps Challenge
sections.summary: The Health Promotion Board's National Steps Challenge is highlighted as one such national initiative.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: One such national initiative I would like to highlight is the Health Promotion Board or HPB's National Steps Challenge.

sections.label: HPB Apple gamification challenge
sections.summary: HPB will partner Apple to use gamification to sustain interest in a challenge, with extrinsic rewards used to change societal behaviour.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: This challenge had a few waves to reignite and sustain interest after the initial novelty wears off.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: And most recently, HPB will also be partnering Apple to leverage on gamification to continue the excitement in this challenge and achieve its social objective.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: In line with exploring the use of alternatives and behavioural science to shape societal behaviour, I would like to ask the Minister: (a) Notably, a lot of extrinsic rewards have been used to spur a change in societal behaviour.

sections.label: Mandatory cleaning standards Bill
sections.summary: The Bill implements mandatory cleaning standards for specified premises, so operators of premises with poor hygiene may be held accountable.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Bill before us implements mandatory cleaning standards for specified premises and will, indeed, go towards ensuring that premises which have poor hygiene standards may result in operators being held accountable.

sections.label: Environmental services industry workers
sections.summary: Singapore's environmental services industry employs about 78,000 workers, almost two-thirds aged 55 and above, and is targeted by the Progressive Wage Model.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Back in Singapore, our environmental services industry is estimated to employ approximately 78,000 workers with almost two-thirds of employed residents in the sector aged 55 and above.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: It is one of the industries targeted by our much-vaunted Progressive Wage Model which tells us that these are possibly low-pay, low-status jobs, a future which parents threaten their kids with if they do not study hard enough The reality though, is that the pandemic and associated lockdowns around the world have shown that cleaners are key frontline workers keeping economies and societies running while running risks to their own and their families' health.

sections.label: Ageing demographics and low-wage workers
sections.summary: Ageing demographics mean it will become unrealistic to keep relying on low-wage, low-status workers, often foreign or elderly, to maintain cleanliness standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Likewise, our ageing demographics also tell us that there will come a point where it will become unrealistic to keep relying on low-wage, low-status workers, often either foreign or elderly, to maintain cleanliness standards while we continue to treat them as being unimportant and invisible.

sections.label: Pandemic and environmental sanitation standards
sections.summary: The pandemic highlights environmental hygiene and public health, and the Bill mandates environmental sanitation standards for cleaning high-risk premises, raising cleaning costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The pandemic is also a wake-up call, highlighting the importance of things that we have all taken for granted, such as environmental hygiene and public health.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: This Bill mandates environmental sanitation (ES) standards for the cleaning and disinfection of high-risk premises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: This means that cleaning costs will go up.

sections.label: Toilet Improvement Programme for operators
sections.summary: Coffee shop and hawker centre operators should tap the Toilet Improvement Programme to upgrade and maintain their toilets.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: (In English): Coffee shop and hawker centre operators should tap on the recently launched Toilet Improvement Programme to make the necessary upgrades to their toilets and for proper maintenance.

sections.label: Sustainable cleaning and hygiene legislation
sections.summary: A survey found around 97% of Singapore residents want legislation for higher hygiene standards in public spaces, care centres and food establishments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Is there a more sustainable way to clean and sanitise which can minimise the discharge of chemicals into our environment?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: According to the survey, around 97% of Singapore’s residents would like legislation to ensure higher hygiene standards for public spaces, including care centres for the young and elderly, and food establishments.

sections.label: Tray Return Programme progress
sections.summary: The question asks the Minister to share the Tray Return Programme's progress, learning experience and possible measures to boost public participation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the Minister also share the progress of the Tray Return Programme, the learning experience so far and what improvement measures may be introduced to boost public participation in this initiative?

sections.label: Toilet Improvement Programme funding
sections.summary: The NEA launched the Toilet Improvement Programme, letting hawker centres and coffee-shops apply for up to 90% funding to improve toilets and cleanliness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The NEA launched the Toilet Improvement Programme which allows hawker centres and coffee-shops to apply for up to 90% funding to improve their toilets and level of cleanliness.

sections.label: Funding for coffee-shop smoking corners
sections.summary: The question asks whether NEA would fund coffee-shops under the Toilet Improvement Programme if they keep smoking corners and build an enclosed smokers' area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Would the NEA consider providing funding support under the same Toilet Improvement Programme for coffee-shops which do not wish to remove their smoking corners to build an enclosed area for smokers?

sections.label: Numbers of cleaners in Singapore
sections.summary: Cleaners in Singapore declined from more than 7,000 in 1961 to 2,100 in 1989, and today number 58,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: From 1961 to 1989, the number of cleaners working in Singapore had declined from more than 7,000 to 2,100.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Today, Singapore currently has an army of 58,000 workers in the cleaning industry.

sections.label: Bill and stakeholder accountability
sections.summary: The Bill goes some way to keep businesses and the state accountable for their role in maintaining public health.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Where businesses and the state are concerned, the Bill goes some way to keep these stakeholders accountable for their role in maintaining public health.

sections.label: Cleanliness and civic-mindedness values
sections.summary: The passage calls for cleanliness and civic-mindedness as common values so Singapore moves from a cleaned city to a clean city.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: As we aim to improve sanitation standards in Singapore by way of legislation, let us bring cleanliness and civic-mindedness back as our common values, and move from being a being merely a cleaned city to a clean city.

sections.label: Mandatory sanitation standards for high-risk premises
sections.summary: The passage states that introducing mandatory environmental sanitation standards for cleaning and disinfection of high-risk premises is necessary and timely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Introducing mandatory environmental sanitation standards for the cleaning and disinfection of high-risk premises is necessary and timely.

sections.label: Half-day cleaners' training programme
sections.summary: The passage states that the half-day cleaners' training programme launched by NEA and the Restroom Association last month is very useful.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The half-day cleaners' training programme launched by NEA and the Restroom Association last month is very useful.

sections.label: Funding for coffee shop toilets
sections.summary: The passage states that interested coffee shops and hawker centre operators may apply for up to 90% funding to improve toilets and cleaning measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Interested coffee shops and hawker centre operators may apply for up to 90% funding to improve the design and cleanliness of their toilets and adopt more effective cleaning measures.

sections.label: Public Cleanliness Satisfaction Survey finding
sections.summary: The passage states that 87% of respondents in the Public Cleanliness Satisfaction Survey think Singapore is clean due to cleaners' efficiency.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Most of us recognise that we can do more to help at the individual level, as highlighted in the Public Cleanliness Satisfaction Survey, we found that 87% of the respondents think that Singapore is clean due to the efficiency of the cleaners.

sections.label: Awarding contracts to progressive employers
sections.summary: The passage states businesses and Government agencies should award cleaning contracts to progressive employers and look at ECO and ECC jobs as the pinnacle of the PWM for cleaners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Businesses and Government agencies should award cleaning contracts to progressive employers who upskill and reward their workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: We should also be bold and look at ECO and ECC jobs as the pinnacle of the Progressive Wage Model or PWM for cleaners.

sections.label: Tray return survey findings
sections.summary: In SMU's third Public Cleanliness Satisfaction Survey, 36% of respondents were unsure whether trays should be returned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: In the third Public Cleanliness Satisfaction Survey undertaken by SMU, 36% of respondents said they were unsure whether trays should be returned.

sections.label: Fines for the offence
sections.summary: Upon conviction, the offence carries a fine of up to $5,000 for the first offence and up to $10,000 for later offences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Upon conviction, the offence attracts a fine not exceeding $5,000 on the first offence and a fine not exceeding $10,000 for the second or subsequent offences.

sections.label: Non-monetary sanctions for non-compliance
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Minister will consider non-monetary sanctions, including suspensions of operations, to supplement existing fines.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: In the event of persistent contravention of the Act, will the Minister look into imposing non-monetary sanctions, including suspensions of operations to supplement the existing fine structure to send a stronger deterrent signal against non-compliance?

sections.label: Surface transmission and environmental hygiene
sections.summary: COVID-19 can be acquired from contaminated surfaces, where the virus can survive two to three days, so regular cleaning and disinfection reduce transmission risk.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: COVID-19 can be acquired through contact with surfaces contaminated with the virus and laboratory tests have demonstrated that the virus can survive on surfaces for two to three days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: As such, ensuring environmental hygiene through regular cleaning and disinfection of places with high volume of people minimises the risk of transmission.

sections.label: Director-General directives to clean premises
sections.summary: The speaker supports expanding the Director-General's powers to issue cleaning or disinfection directives, including closing premises for up to 14 days.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: While I also support the move to expand the powers of the Director-General to issue directives to any entity or persons to clean and/or disinfect the premises from the first warning signs of a potential health risk or disease outbreak, we are also aware that viruses do not only have an impact on health, but also on the economy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: These expanded powers include the possibility of the Director-General giving a directive to close the relevant premises, or any part of the relevant premises, for a period not exceeding 14 days for the purpose of cleaning and disinfecting – such cleaning and disinfecting to take place in a manner and within the time specified in such directive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The discretion to make these directives will need to be weighed carefully and I know that premise managers will be wondering what sort of manner and time period is likely to be specified, as businesses need to plan for these possibilities and this will incur cost.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I am also heartened that individuals who are required to carry out the disinfecting of the relevant premises will need to be provided with appropriate personal protective equipment.

sections.label: New environmental jobs and careers
sections.summary: New jobs like environmental manager, coordinator and officer are hoped to create career pathways and better salaries for frontline officers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: With the establishment of new jobs such as the environmental manager, the environmental control coordinator and the environmental control officer, I hope that this will create new career development pathways for our frontline officers so that they can upskill and obtain better salaries.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I hope that businesses will give priority to local workers to take on these new jobs.

sections.label: Environmental Public Health Amendment Bill
sections.summary: MP supports the Bill and urges time for industry, citing cleaning standards for high-risk premises and aquatic and air-conditioning systems.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Keeping Singapore clean is a shared responsibility, and even as the Ministry introduces heightened standards for the protection of our people, I urge the Ministry to work with industry and give sufficient time for industry and our workforce to respond.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Notwithstanding my suggestions expressed in this speech, I support the Environmental Public Health (Amendment) Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: For locations visited by COVID-19 patients, we follow the practice of disinfecting and deep cleaning residential, work or public places.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: However, in situations related to cleaning of high-risk premises, such as pre-schools and eldercare facilities, and locations where many people share the same body of water or recirculated air, namely, (a) swimming pools, spas and water playgrounds and (b) central air-conditioning systems, there should be maintenance standards and practices set for these areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: So, it is timely that the Government strengthens and mandates maintenance standards as well as placing accountability on premises managers that have aquatic facilities or licensable aerosol-generating systems.

sections.label: Resident feedback on cigarette smoke
sections.summary: MP received resident feedback on neighbour cigarette smoke, coinciding with a report of 11,400 NEA feedback cases from January to April, a 21% rise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Over the last few months, I had received many feedback from residents about exposure to cigarette smoke floating into their flats from neighbours who smoke.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This trend coincides with The Straits Times report that NEA received 11,400 cases of feedback for the period January to April this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Derrick Goh (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This represents a 21% increase in cases related to smoking in residential homes and corridors.

sections.label: SME compliance costs for requirements
sections.summary: SMEs of specific premises must incorporate new ECC/ECO requirements as additional compliance costs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: SMEs of specific premises will need to incorporate these new ECC/ECO requirements as additional compliance costs.

sections.label: Phased approach for SME implementation
sections.summary: A phased approach is needed to help SMEs implement the regulatory requirements and gradually achieve the required standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: A phased approach is needed to help SMEs implement these regulatory requirements to gradually achieve the required standards.

sections.label: Measures, costs and downtime questions
sections.summary: MP asks the Minister what measures reduce implementation bottlenecks and downtime, and the estimated annual costs and downtime for hawker centres, kopitiams, markets and merchants.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask the Minister what measures will be taken to reduce bottlenecks during implementation and avoid unnecessary downtime for businesses?

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong (Jurong)
sentences.text: And what are the estimated annual costs and expected downtime for hawker centres, kopitiams, neighbourhood markets and small neighbourhood merchants?

sections.label: SMU study on toilet cleanliness
sections.summary: An SMU study found toilet cleanliness has regressed compared to 2016.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: According to a recent study by SMU, the cleanliness of our toilets has regressed compared to 2016.

sections.label: Premises with high footfall
sections.summary: These premises cover five high-footfall categories with immune-vulnerable occupants: childcare facilities, schools and youth facilities, eldercare facilities, hawker centres and coffee shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: These premises apply to five categories with high footfall and immune-vulnerable occupants.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: They are childcare facilities, schools and youth facilities, eldercare facilities, hawker centres and coffee shops.

sections.label: Germs on free weights
sections.summary: Free weights were found to contain 362 times more germs than toilet seats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For instance, free weights were found to contain 362 times more germs than toilet seats.

sections.label: Gym users and EPHA scope
sections.summary: Everyone goes to the gym to keep fit, not to fall ill, so MSE is urged to consider including sporting facilities under the EPHA.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Young and old alike, everyone goes to the gym to keep fit and not to fall ill from a bacteria or viral infection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Hence, I urge MSE to consider the inclusion of sporting facilities under the scope of the EPHA.

sections.label: Cleanliness grading and incentive system
sections.summary: A cleanliness grading system and an incentive system linked to premises licence renewal or property tax rebate are suggested to encourage proactive hygiene control.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: First, we suggest the implementation of a cleanliness grading system and also an incentive system which will link to the premises licence renewal or property tax rebate, so as to encourage proactive control of hygiene standards.

sections.label: Other premises posing health threats
sections.summary: MSE is urged to consider whether the Bill should include other premises posing public health threats, such as sports facilities and religious worship venues.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Third, we suggest that MSE to deeply consider if the Bill should also include other premises that may pose threats to public health, such as sports facilities and religious worship venues.

sections.label: Courses for senior cleaners
sections.summary: About 40,000 are locals, most above 60, so Environment Control Coordinator courses should be conducted in languages senior cleaners understand.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Amongst them, about 40,000 are locals and most of them are above 60 years old.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Therefore, the courses for Environment Control Coordinator designated by Amendments to the Environmental Public Health Act Bill, should be conducted in languages understood by the senior cleaners.

sections.label: Tray return rates increase
sections.summary: Tray return rates rose at Zion Riverside and Adam Road Food Centres by 19 and 42 percentage points respectively.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Mr Gan Thiam Poh would be happy to know that this helped to increase tray return rates at Zion Riverside Food Centre and Adam Road Food Centre by 19 percentage points and 42 percentage points respectively.

sections.label: SG Clean Quality Mark premises
sections.summary: Over 24,000 premises have acquired the SG Clean Quality Mark, assuring occupants that the premises are clean.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Over 24,000 premises have acquired the SG Clean Quality Mark which provides a stamp of assurance to occupants that the premises are clean.

sections.label: Small coffee shop ECC appointment
sections.summary: NEA will allow a few small coffee shop owners to collectively appoint one ECC for their premises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Every coffee shop needs only one person to be appointed as an ECC and that person can be an outlet supervisor, doing it as part of his or her function.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Smaller coffee shops may face more manpower constraints.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, taking in their feedback, NEA will allow a few small coffee shop owners to collectively appoint one ECC for their premises, for economies of scale if they should require so or should they prefer to do so.

sections.label: Environmental sanitation regime start
sections.summary: Implementation of the environmental sanitation regime will commence from mid-2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Implementation of the environmental sanitation regime will commence from mid-2021.

sections.label: NEA approved applications and grants
sections.summary: As of 30 September 2020, NEA has approved 791 applications with a total grant amount of $15.3 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As of 30 September 2020, NEA has approved 791 applications, with a total grant amount of $15.3 million.

sections.label: Cleaners training subsidy upgrade
sections.summary: Local cleaners can upgrade through Continuing Education and Training courses on environmental infection control with up to 90% training subsidy from SSG.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Local cleaners performing general cleaning duties can also upgrade themselves by enrolling into the Continuing Education and Training courses on environmental infection control, with up to 90% training subsidy from SSG.

sections.label: Cleaner wages under PWM
sections.summary: Real median monthly gross wages of full-time resident cleaners rose 26% from 2014 to 2019, above the workforce median of 21%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: With enhancements to the PWM, real median monthly gross wages of full-time resident cleaners have increased by 26% from 2014 to 2019, higher than the workforce’s median of 21%.

sections.label: Environmental sanitation job enhancements
sections.summary: Up to 15,700 ECC and ECO jobs are expected to be enhanced under the environmental sanitation regime in the next few years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: In the next few years, we expect to enhance up to 15,700 ECC and ECO jobs under the environmental sanitation regime.

sections.label: Food establishment licensing framework
sections.summary: SFA will introduce a licensing and recognition framework requiring food establishments to have good food safety and cleanliness track records, with Premises Managers more accountable.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Nonetheless, SFA will be introducing a new licensing and recognition framework for food establishments which will require them to have good track records on food safety and cleanliness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Major lapses in toilet cleanliness could conceivably affect their licence duration, which means they will have to go through audits more frequently, if they have a shorter licence duration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Public hygiene has always been a priority for the Government, but we must do more following COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: This Bill marks a new milestone to keep Singapore clean by placing greater accountability on Premises Managers to strengthen public hygiene in their premises.

sections.label: Gastroenteritis incidents 2018 to 2019
sections.summary: Gastroenteritis incidents between 2018 and 2019, linked to contaminated environments, affected more than 1,200 people.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The gastroenteritis incidents between 2018 to 2019, which were linked to contaminated environments, affected more than 1,200 people.

sections.label: Environmental Public Health Amendment Bill
sections.summary: The Bill sets minimum environmental sanitation standards for specific premises, making Premises Managers responsible, implemented progressively from mid-2021 starting with higher-risk premises.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment has introduced the Environmental Public Health (Amendment) Bill, as part of our SG Clean movement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Through these legislative changes, we will set minimum environmental sanitation standards for specific premises and make Premises Managers responsible for ensuring that these standards are met.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: We will progressively implement these standards from mid-2021, starting with higher-risk premises with immuno-vulnerable occupants, high footfall or a history of outbreaks, such as our preschools, schools, youth and eldercare facilities, hawker centres and coffee shops.

sections.label: Public hygiene jobs and training
sections.summary: Raising public hygiene standards is expected to create new jobs and upgrade existing ones, with workers undergoing technical training, while end-users also play their part.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   By raising overall standards for public hygiene, we also hope to create new jobs and upgrade existing ones.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: For example, with the introduction of the environmental sanitation regime, we will require premises managers to upskill existing workers and some larger enterprises may employ new workers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: These workers will undergo technical training to develop, implement and monitor plans to raise cleanliness in line with the environmental sanitation standards.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: While the Government puts in place these measures to improve public hygiene in Singapore, it is also important that all of us, as end-users, customers or patrons, also play our part.
